versions.changelog:
Initial release of naim-mcp skill:

- Connects to nAIm, an API registry for AI agents with over 267 services.
- Browse, search, and compare APIs by category, pricing model, and authentication type.
- View and submit ratings (cost, quality, latency, reliability) for any service.
- No API key required; integrates via SSE for real-time updates.
- Provides registry stats and usage examples for easy onboarding.
